codeReview.summary: The commit cleanly removes the requested dead selectors for `.fab-legacy-actions`, `.balance-popover*`, `.composer-legacy-controls`, `.mascot-antenna*`, and `.mascot-cheeks*`, and the handoff documents a successful build for VAL-CSS-004. However, the feature still does not satisfy VAL-CSS-002 because `.message-header` remains defined in `chat.css` and is still emitted by active sidepanel rendering code.

issues.description: `VAL-CSS-002` is not met: `.message-header` was part of this feature's removal list but the selector still exists here (and again at line 1981). Active UI renderers still emit `.message-header` markup in `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/chat/chat-assistant-new.ts:40`, `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/chat/chat-display-user.ts:20`, `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/chat/chat-assistant-streamed.ts:47-49`, `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/history/history-render.ts:23,32`, and `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/agents/panel-agent-nav.ts:142`, so the implementation cannot both preserve behavior and satisfy the current contract as written.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission feature metadata/validation contract labels `.message-header` as unused, but multiple active sidepanel render paths still generate that class. Shared cleanup guidance should require a quick source-reference audit before a selector is listed as dead CSS.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Mission feature `remove-unused-css-selectors` and `validation-contract.md` target `.message-header`; active emitters exist in `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/chat/chat-assistant-new.ts:40`, `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/chat/chat-display-user.ts:20`, `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/chat/chat-assistant-streamed.ts:47-49`, `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/history/history-render.ts:23,32`, and `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/agents/panel-agent-nav.ts:142`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The status module still imports a `balance-popover` helper that references DOM ids for a popover UI, but no matching sidepanel template nodes were found. That makes the removed `.balance-popover*` CSS appear genuinely dead, and also suggests a separate stale-JS cleanup opportunity that is not recorded in shared state.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/status/panel-status.ts:6` imports `./balance-popover.js`; `packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/status/balance-popover.ts:12,26,38-40` queries `balancePopover`, `balanceSessionTokens`, `balanceCreditsValue`, `balancePlanValue`, and `balanceSpendValue`; grep across `packages/extension/sidepanel/templates/**/*.html` found no matching ids.

summary: Review failed for contract compliance: the landed commit is safe for the selectors it removed and the recorded build evidence supports VAL-CSS-004, but VAL-CSS-002 remains unmet because `.message-header` is still present and actively used.
